description: The group begins separating into new lives as Monica and Chandler pursue adoption and a suburban home, Phoebe marries Mike, Rachel considers moving to Paris and Ross finally confronts what losing her would mean.

s10e01.description: Joey and Rachel try to understand their new romance after Barbados while Ross begins a relationship with Charlie, leaving all four increasingly uncomfortable around one another.

s10e02.description: Ross insists he is completely fine with Joey and Rachel dating, then proves the opposite during an excruciating double-date dinner.

s10e03.description: Ross's attempt at a spray tan goes disastrously wrong, while Joey and Rachel struggle to make their physical relationship feel natural.

s10e04.description: An obscene cake is mistakenly delivered for Emma's birthday, sending Rachel and Ross on a frantic effort to replace it before the party.

s10e05.description: Rachel lets Amy babysit Emma despite Ross's objections, and Amy promptly makes an outrageous decision about the baby's appearance.

s10e06.description: Ross interviews for a research grant from Charlie's former boyfriend and suspects jealousy is sabotaging him, while Monica and Rachel fight over Phoebe's bizarre artwork.

s10e07.description: Monica and Chandler prepare for an adoption home study, but Joey's intervention and a forgotten past relationship threaten the evaluator's impression.

s10e08.description: Monica and Chandler refuse to let the others into Thanksgiving after everyone arrives late, until unexpected adoption news changes the evening.

s10e09.description: Monica and Chandler meet a pregnant woman considering them as adoptive parents, but a mix-up makes her believe they are a doctor and reverend.

s10e10.description: Phoebe and Rachel see Chandler entering a house with a woman and suspect an affair, only to discover he and Monica are secretly planning to move to the suburbs.

s10e11.description: Phoebe's bachelorette party goes badly when the stripper is not what anyone expected, while Ross and Chandler revisit an embarrassing college pact.

s10e12.description: A blizzard ruins Phoebe and Mike's elaborate wedding plans, so the friends improvise a simple ceremony in the snow outside Central Perk.

s10e13.description: Phoebe tries to teach Joey French for an audition with hopeless results, while Ross and Rachel confront her father's reaction to their living arrangement.

s10e14.description: Phoebe changes her name to Princess Consuela Banana Hammock, prompting Mike to retaliate, while Monica and Chandler learn the house next door may belong to Janice.

s10e15.description: Joey's agent Estelle dies and Phoebe tries to spare his feelings, while Ross attempts to stop Rachel from taking a job in Paris.

s10e16.description: Rachel says goodbye to each friend before leaving for Paris but initially excludes Ross, provoking the confrontation that finally leads them back to bed together.

s10e17-18.description: As Monica and Chandler prepare to leave the apartment and Rachel prepares for Paris, Ross races to tell Rachel he loves her and the six friends close their final chapter together.
